active_work_package.title: Recover RS-485 acquisition after serial EIO without poisoning the bus session
active_work_package.selection_reason: Controlled #368 acceptance found that a serial EIO poisoned the shared cached Modbus descriptor and stopped all telemetry while central services remained healthy. This critical runtime recovery defect must be corrected before #368 hardware acceptance can be meaningful.

next_selection_policy: Finish #374 software verification and merge, prove Raspberry Pi acquisition freshness with the recovered Device Agent, resume #368 migration-v2/latest-query acceptance, then execute #369, #366 and #289 in that order.
